name: Patapata Kimito.
source:
When I woke up, my body was no longer human.

The chemical I was exposed to during the mission. My altered senses, and the swaying of my ears and tail.
My former strength, my pride—everything was fading away into the mist.
Yet there were people who smiled at me. People who spoke to me.
So, just one more time—I wanted to reach out to this world.
translation:
当我醒来时，我的身体已经不再是人类了。

我在任务期间接触到的化学物质。我的感官发生了变化，耳朵和尾巴也开始摇摆。
我曾经的力量，我的骄傲——一切都消失在迷雾之中。
但还是有人对我微笑。和我说话的人。
所以，再一次——我想接触这个世界。
